basics.name: Noel De Martin
basics.label: Senior Product Engineer
basics.summary: I'm a Senior Product Engineer with 10+ years of experience. I have led multiple shifts in architecture, as well as built systems from scratch. I thrive in remote environments, and I love to bridge engineering and design in order to deliver the best product and user experience.

workIntro: (Psst, if you want a TLDR of my skills and experience check out [noeldemartin.com/brag](/brag))

work.name: Altworth
highlights: Architected the frontend and Backend-for-Frontend for a collectibles e-commerce platform, bridging the payment system with the user interface.
Modernized the codebase by introducing SOLID principles, automated testing, and strict TypeScript typing.

work.name: Accountali
highlights: Architected an accounting B2B SaaS platform, integrating with Amazon's Selling Partner API and creating processing pipelines.
Automated Amazon Seller Central invoice processing with a custom browser extension.

work.name: Moodle
highlights: Lead the architecture and development of the [Apps Portal](https://apps.moodle.com/), a bespoke billing platform.
Achieved WCAG 2.1AA accreditation for the [Moodle App](https://moodle.com/solutions/moodle-app/), an Open Source mobile app with millions of daily active users.
Improved testing strategy and code quality of the Apps team, see this presentation for details: [Moodle App Testing: Then and Now](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LYDFpaDv27o).

work.name: MusicList
highlights: Scaled website with more than 200,000 unique monthly visitors.
Architected data synchronization pipelines by integrating with various 3rd-party services (Spotify, Apple Music, etc.).
Coordinated cross-functional UI/UX and engineering teams to prototype, build, and launch mobile and web applications.

work.name: Geemba
highlights: Co-founded and architected a SaaS platform, designing a microservices architecture and a custom "pay-per-minute" billing engine using Stripe.
Led a cross-functional product team of designers and developers.

work.name: Beast Masters
work.summary: Worked with illustrators, designers, and sound artists to create a cross-platform mobile multiplayer game.

work.name: Toro Intl
work.summary: Relocated 5 months to Taiwan, and implemented a UI toolkit from scratch using drawing primitives in J2ME.

work.name: Veziko
work.summary: Implemented a SaaS platform for restaurants, participating in multiple entrepreneurship formation programs.

projects.name: Apps, Dev tools, and AI
projects.description: I'm always exploring new technologies and learning with side projects, you can find all about them in my website (and [GitHub](https://github.com/noeldemartin)!):
highlights: Working on an AI harness called [Ànima](https://anima.noeldemartin.com/).
Designed and implemented multiple apps, including [Umai](https://umai.noeldemartin.com/), [Media Kraken](https://noeldemartin.github.io/media-kraken/), and [Focus](https://focus.noeldemartin.com/).

Creating [a JavaScript framework](/tasks/making-a-web-application-framework) and [Active Record library](https://soukai.js.org) to make interoperable local-first applications (using the Solid Protocol).
Presented technical deep-dives on my work at various conferences, check out [my talks](/talks).
